title: Mousify
description: New textures for PvP (Player vs Player). PvE (Player vs Entity) And Just overall survival it changes the tools and much more.
body: This pack was design for bedwars but can be used for other purposes such as PvP Or PvE. Its a good pack with many textures i hope you enjoy also have fun. It really doesnt add much but it changes the tools, health, emerald (along with block and ore). And much more.... Id like to say that from now on mousify will be on 1.21.8 due to a mcreator update and yeah.
